title: 第十章 十字路口第十一章 死路
content_zh:
但那孩子却没再继续这个故事，而是突兀地唱起了别的。
“十个小黑人为吃饭而奔走。”
“噎死一个没法救，十个只剩九。”
“九个小黑人，深夜不寐真困乏。”
“倒头一睡睡死啦，九个只剩八。”
.......
怎么又是《鹅妈妈童谣》？
周游皱了皱眉，但还是按照歌声的指示，抬腿，跳出。
........
.......
在此之后，那孩子接连又唱了十几首，不过基本都是世界上比较知名的那种‘黑暗童谣’，但速度是越来越快，周游应对的也是越发艰难。
万幸的事，他总算能坚持下来。
不过就在他即将来到出口的时候，那孩童的声音忽然再度一变。
然而这回响起的声音却已经不是一人独唱——只见那些墙壁上的怪诞面突然间挣脱了束缚，然后也随着他一同唱了起来。
于是那童谣顷刻间变得杂乱而又恐怖，所有的声音都犹如化作实质，被挤压一般强行塞到了耳朵里，只消几句，便会会让人产生一种强烈呕吐出来的**。
“所有的孩子都被带到了那里。”
“那是大老爷的宅邸。”
“房子里阴暗无光，所见处尽是血迹。”
“庄严的菩萨像也已经披上了一层深红色的外衣。”
“孩子们被这景色吓得哭泣不已。

“然而就在此时。”
“他们忽然听到一个声音说。”
“不要怕，千万不要害怕。”
“因为很快的，我们就将融为一体。”
在震耳欲聋的合唱停下来之时，系统的提示也随之响起。
“你受到了侵蚀，理智受损，现存理智为80100。”
——我艹，难度加了？你这连个提醒都没有啊？？
周游咬着牙，忍着理智受损时传来的恍惚感，终于在时限即将到来的时候，找到了一个画着融合躯壳的头颅，跳了上去。
“在此之后。”
“大老爷也终于得到了期待已久的奖励。”
“但是这些仍然不够。”
“永远也都不会足够。”
“所以如果不再找来更多。”
“那么下一个就会是他自己。”
“——你受到了侵蚀，理智受损，现存理智为75100。”
恍惚感越来越严重，周游似乎感觉自己好像又出现了幻觉——就见层层烂肉在巷子中浮现，然后一层一层地堆砌起来，最后化成了一个怪异的脸庞。
不知为何，他总感觉那脸有点熟悉，但此刻已经来不及细想，他朝着周围踅摸一圈，终于找到了个符合的‘老爷’——一张胖乎乎的员外图像——然后急忙跳了下去。
巷子出口已经近在咫尺，可很明显的，对方也不想让他就这么轻松的逃脱，于是最后的歌谣声响起。
“于是孩子们越来越少。”
“直至有一天已经无以为继。”

“大老爷只能放了一把火，毁灭掉了一切证据。”
“可是事情不会就这么走向结局。”
“那么下一个是谁呢？”
content_en:
But the child did not continue the story, but suddenly sang something else.
“Ten little black men running for food.”
"If one chokes to death, there is no way to save him. Only nine out of ten are left."
"Nine little black people, so sleepy late at night."
"I fell asleep and died, there were only eight left out of nine."
.......
Why is it "Mother Goose Nursery Rhyme" again?
Zhou You frowned, but still followed the instructions of the song, raised his legs and jumped out.
........
.......
After that, the child sang more than a dozen songs in succession, but they were basically the well-known 'dark nursery rhymes' in the world, but the speed was getting faster and faster, and it became more and more difficult for Zhou You to deal with it.
Fortunately, he was able to persist.
But just as he was about to reach the exit, the child's voice suddenly changed again.
However, the voice that sounded this time was no longer a solo one - the grotesque faces on the walls suddenly broke free and began to sing along with him.
As a result, the nursery rhyme suddenly became messy and terrifying, and all the sounds seemed to turn into substance, being squeezed and forced into the ears. Just a few words would make people feel the urge to vomit.
"All the children were taken there."
"That's the great master's mansion."
"The house was dark and dark, and there was blood everywhere."
"The solemn Bodhisattva statue has also been covered with a dark red coat."
“The children were so frightened by the sight that they cried.
“But at this moment. "
"They suddenly heard a voice say. "
"Don't be afraid, don't be afraid. "
“Because soon, we will be one. "
When the deafening chorus stopped, the system prompts also sounded.
"You have been eroded and your sanity has been damaged. Your existing sanity is 80100. "
——Holy shit, is it more difficult? You didn’t even get a reminder? ?
Zhou You gritted his teeth and endured the dazed feeling when his sanity was damaged. Finally, when the time limit was approaching, he found a head with a fused body painted on it and jumped on it.
"After this. "
"The great master finally got the long-awaited reward. "
“But this is still not enough. "
“It will never be enough. "
“So if you don’t find more. "
"Then he will be next. "
"——You have been eroded and your sanity has been damaged. Your existing sanity is 75100. "
The trance became more and more serious, and Zhou You seemed to feel like he was hallucinating again - he saw layers of rotten flesh emerging in the alley, and then piled up layer by layer, finally turning into a weird face.
For some reason, he always felt that the face was familiar, but it was too late to think about it at the moment. He looked around and finally found a suitable 'master' - an image of a chubby member - and jumped in hastily.
The exit of the alley was already close at hand, but it was obvious that the other party didn't want him to escape so easily, so the last song sounded.
“So there were fewer and fewer kids. "
“Until one day it was no longer possible. "
"The old man could only set a fire and destroy all the evidence. "
“But things won’t end like this. "
"So who's next? "
